description: This file contains a Python class implementation for controlling and managing a FVP (Fixed Virtual Platform) target, including state transitions, console setup, and command execution, primarily used for testing in an embedded Linux environment.

classes.name: OEFVPTargetState
classes.description: An enumeration representing the possible states of the FVP target: OFF, ON, and LINUX.

classes.name: OEFVPTarget
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle and interaction with a FVP target, including starting, stopping, transitioning states, and setting up consoles.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the FVP target with configuration parameters, setting up paths, and initial state.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Handles transitioning the FVP target between OFF, ON, and LINUX states with appropriate setup and checks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Placeholder method for starting the FVP target lazily.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Transitions the FVP target to the OFF state.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a command on the FVP target, ensuring it is in the LINUX state beforehand.

methods.name: _setup_consoles
methods.description: Sets up console terminals based on the FVP configuration, creating log files and symlinks.

methods.name: _create_logfile
methods.description: Creates and manages log files for console output, including symlinks.

methods.name: _get_terminal
methods.description: Retrieves a terminal object by name.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Dynamically exposes methods of the pexpect API on the target, allowing calls with terminal name as the first argument.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Property that retrieves the current FVP configuration.
